transcribed_question:
A. Nerve supply to the area painted blue
B. If omentum is an anatomical sphincter True or False
C. What is the arterial supply to the area painted yellow

marker.description: Yellow paint marking an area on the specimen

main_question: What is the arterial supply to the area painted yellow?
main_explanation: The greater omentum is supplied by the right and left gastroepiploic (gastroomental) arteries, which run along its free border.

supporting_question.question: Which of the following statements regarding the greater omentum is correct?
options: It is supplied by the splenic artery
It is supplied by the gastroepiploic arteries
It is innervated by the phrenic nerve
supporting_question.explanation: The greater omentum is not a sphincter. It is supplied by the gastroepiploic arteries and is innervated by the vagus nerve and sympathetic fibers, not the phrenic nerve.

true_false.statement: The greater omentum is an anatomical sphincter.
true_false.explanation: The omentum is a fold of peritoneum and does not function as a sphincter.
